source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public, 2021 release, AWS Open Data
product_type: Digital Surface Model (DSM), not bare-earth DTM
vertical_datum: EGM2008 geoid, per Copernicus DEM product documentation; confirm against product handbook for survey-grade work
vertical_accuracy: absolute <4 m LE90; relative <2 m LE90 for slopes <=20%, <4 m for slopes >20%
license: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public is free for general public use under Copernicus terms; include required attribution.
higher_resolution_check: Copernicus EEA-10 is European coverage and does not cover KIET in Uttar Pradesh; no freely downloadable 10 m Copernicus product covering this site was used.
alternative_baseline: NASA SRTMGL1 v3 is also approximately 30 m and openly accessible; Copernicus GLO-30 was selected as the primary baseline.
attribution: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
limitations: 30 m DSM cells and meter-scale vertical error are insufficient for survey-grade campus drainage/flood depths. Buildings/vegetation may be present. A local RTK/LiDAR/total-station survey is required for engineering-grade modeling.
